# CopilotForge - Champions

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Create evidence-led Champion programmes that turn curiosity into capability and capability into contribution, with clear boundaries on what Champions do and do not do.

- **Layer:** adoption
- **Lead role:** Champions Programme Owner
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-champions`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`capability-framework`](skills/capability-framework/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Measure | Defines the three Champion capabilities - Chat, productivity and agents - each with an objective, a training option, an evidence option, verification criteria and an outcome, so training is one route rather than the gate, and maps learning sessions open to the wider business onto the journey. Use when setting what a Champion must show, when status needs to mean something, or when experienced colleagues want to skip training. |
| [`champion-challenges`](skills/champion-challenges/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Deliver, Scale | Designs the Champion Challenge - one practical contribution after the three capabilities are verified, such as an envisioning workshop, team training, a governed business agent, a prompt library, a departmental playbook or support for the Centre of Excellence - with a safety and scope check and assessment on impact, reusability, quality and strategic alignment. Use when Champions are ready to contribute or a challenge idea needs checking. |
| [`champion-programme-design`](skills/champion-programme-design/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable | Designs an evidence-led Copilot Champions programme as a progression system - purpose, the six-stage journey, operating boundaries, its place between the adoption programme and the Centre of Excellence, sponsorship, agreed time, community, tracker and self-service guidance. Use when starting or replicating a Champion network, when Champions have become an unpaid help desk, or when status means attendance. |
| [`evidence-assessment`](skills/evidence-assessment/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Assure | Sets up fair, consistent assessment of Champion evidence against each capability's verification criteria and of Champion Challenges, by trained assessors who assess the evidence rather than the person, keep a restricted progress tracker, give useful feedback, handle appeals and never rank anyone. Use when submissions start arriving, when assessors disagree, when progress status is unclear or when a decision is challenged. |
| [`recognition-and-progression`](skills/recognition-and-progression/SKILL.md) | draft | Measure, Scale, Improve | Designs how Champions progress through the six-stage journey to recognised Champion, with recognition linked to demonstrated contribution, access to advanced materials, pilots and specialist pathways, renewal, a regular programme health check and programme-level measures such as milestone conversion. Use when designing Champion recognition, when status has gone stale, or when a sponsor asks whether the programme is healthy. |
